'''Kor Desilijic''' was a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region. It featured expansive [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] as well as great [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] established Kor Desilijic as a [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] while the clan was regaining its power and prestige following the end of the [[Hutt Cataclysms]] around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The planet housed vast estates, including the ancient [[Rasmal Valley Palace]], that the Desilijic used to store their large amount of accumulated treasure as well as a vacation site and a secure hideout when needed.

==Description==
Kor Desilijic was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH" /> located in the [[Kor Desilijic system/Legends|Kor Desilijic system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlanes]] linked it to the [[Gos Hutta system/Legends|Gos Hutta]], [[Groth system/Legends|Groth]], and [[Huloon system/Legends|Huloon systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The surface of Kor Desilijic featured great ranges of tall, rocky [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], the valleys between which were covered in expansive lowlands and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. Dank mist enveloped the latter.<ref name="LoNH" />

==History==
After the series of calamities and conflicts known as the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], which had led to the collapse of the [[Hutt Empire]], ended<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] rebuilt its lost power and prestige. As part of that process, the Hutt [[Rasmal Desilijic Bansek]] defeated eight other clans for the rights to the planet that would become known as Kor Desilijic. Rasmal's clan subsequently made the world into a [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] situated at the center of Desilijic-held territory.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Desilijic/Legends}}
[[File:Desilijic_clan_vector.svg|thumb|right|180px|Kor Desilijic served as the throneworld of the Desilijic clan (emblem pictured).]]
The Hutts of the Desilijic clan used Kor Desilijic as a vacation site and, when needed, as a secure safehouse-like hideout, which drew on the Hutt clans' societal pressure against attacking any given clan's throneworld. Such use of Kor Desilijic, combined with the vast treasure holdings the Desilijic stored there, led to numerous layers of the best security the clan could purchase protecting the entire planet. Due to those security measures, it was even more difficult for rivals to insert [[Spy/Legends|spies]] or [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] on Kor Desilijic than it was on other throneworlds.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Locations==
Kor Desilijic housed ancient, vast Desilijic estates, with many of the largest such residences being constructed in the planet's swamps. Others, however, were situated atop its highest mountain peaks, above the mist covering the swamps. The excessively opulent [[Rasmal Valley Palace]], named after Rasmal Desilijic Bansek, was one of the planet's oldest and most revered estates. Among its various structures were entertainment halls able to accommodate hundreds of Hutts at a [[Time/Legends|time]]. Large underground vaults in Kor Desilijic's estates stored the vast treasure and cherished trophies the clan had accumulated over [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], including precious [[Metal/Legends|metals]] worth inestimable sums of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Desilijic was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
